Pricing models

How engagements are priced.

Monthly marketing

An agreed monthly scope covers search, content or social campaigns. Marketing retainers typically begin with a three-month term. Advertising spend is budgeted separately.

Projects and advice

An audit or a defined consulting project has a written scope, milestones and deliverables. Site size, complexity, available data and team capacity affect the quote.

Healthcare revenue

The billing proposal may use a per-claim fee or a share of collections. Claim volume, payer mix and the work retained by your practice affect the model.
